fusions.name: Rack Toss
fusions.desc: Lowers the tines and tosses them up through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Spooked Flick
fusions.desc: A flick of one tine that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You move 12% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Sprung Aside
fusions.desc: You spring 2 tiles aside and lower the tines: the damage you take is reduced by 20% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Twelve Pointer
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
